meta.title: Terrifying Secret
meta.description: A secret known only to these two sisters.

units.rawText: In the hidden passage inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, the trio hold onto the rails for dear life, fighting against the bumpiness of high-speed movement.
units.displayText: In the hidden passage inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, the trio hold onto the rails for dear life, fighting against the bumpiness of high-speed movement.

spans.text: In the hidden passage inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, the trio hold onto the rails for dear life, fighting against the bumpiness of high-speed movement.

units.rawText: I-Isn't this a little bit too fast?
units.displayText: I-Isn't this a little bit too fast?

spans.text: I-Isn't this a little bit too fast?

units.rawText: I've disabled the speed limit for now for us to make good time, deal with it!
units.displayText: I've disabled the speed limit for now for us to make good time, deal with it!

spans.text: I've disabled the speed limit for now for us to make good time, deal with it!

units.rawText: Eucharist has activated the Tower's defense terminal and I don't have the permissions to turn it off. We need to get to the Pantheon before it closes down for good!
units.displayText: Eucharist has activated the Tower's defense terminal and I don't have the permissions to turn it off. We need to get to the Pantheon before it closes down for good!

spans.text: Eucharist has activated the Tower's defense terminal and I don't have the permissions to turn it off. We need to get to the Pantheon before it closes down for good!

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll leans forth, looking towards the upper layers.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll leans forth, looking towards the upper layers.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll leans forth, looking towards the upper layers.

units.rawText: A staggering number of Entropics await at the tunnel's end ahead, screeching as they launch attacks at the group.
units.displayText: A staggering number of Entropics await at the tunnel's end ahead, screeching as they launch attacks at the group.

spans.text: A staggering number of Entropics await at the tunnel's end ahead, screeching as they launch attacks at the group.

units.rawText: We're about 30 seconds out! Angelus! We need all of these Entropics blocking the door out of our way!
units.displayText: We're about 30 seconds out! Angelus! We need all of these Entropics blocking the door out of our way!

spans.text: We're about 30 seconds out! Angelus! We need all of these Entropics blocking the door out of our way!

units.rawText: Understood!
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Receiving the command, the Sanctifier immediately leaps off a corner of the platform, her mechanical wings extending midair as she spirals upwards in the operand-formed passage.
units.displayText: Receiving the command, the Sanctifier immediately leaps off a corner of the platform, her mechanical wings extending midair as she spirals upwards in the operand-formed passage.

spans.text: Receiving the command, the Sanctifier immediately leaps off a corner of the platform, her mechanical wings extending midair as she spirals upwards in the operand-formed passage.

units.rawText: Countless arrows of light appear beside her, remaining still for a moment upon the bowstring before they speed towards their targets.
units.displayText: Countless arrows of light appear beside her, remaining still for a moment upon the bowstring before they speed towards their targets.

spans.text: Countless arrows of light appear beside her, remaining still for a moment upon the bowstring before they speed towards their targets.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: She cares not for the explosions behind her, nocking, drawing, loosing... Repeating the same simple motion, she removes the obstacle in but a few seconds.
units.displayText: She cares not for the explosions behind her, nocking, drawing, loosing... Repeating the same simple motion, she removes the obstacle in but a few seconds.

spans.text: She cares not for the explosions behind her, nocking, drawing, loosing... Repeating the same simple motion, she removes the obstacle in but a few seconds.

units.rawText: As the smoke from the explosion dissipates, the enemies are nowhere to be seen; only the dozens of golden arrows embedded in the wall remain.
units.displayText: As the smoke from the explosion dissipates, the enemies are nowhere to be seen; only the dozens of golden arrows embedded in the wall remain.

spans.text: As the smoke from the explosion dissipates, the enemies are nowhere to be seen; only the dozens of golden arrows embedded in the wall remain.

units.rawText: Good work, Angelus!
units.displayText: Good work, Angelus!

spans.text: Good work, Angelus!

units.rawText: Hey... Antonina, how are we going to decelerate later?
units.displayText: Hey... Antonina, how are we going to decelerate later?

spans.text: Hey... Antonina, how are we going to decelerate later?

units.rawText: The physical way. Watch your tongue, yeah?
units.displayText: The physical way. Watch your tongue, yeah?

spans.text: The physical way. Watch your tongue, yeah?

units.rawText: That smile... wait!
units.displayText: That smile... wait!

spans.text: That smile... wait!

units.rawText: The sensation of inertia strikes again, pushing the two through the closing door together.
units.displayText: The sensation of inertia strikes again, pushing the two through the closing door together.

spans.text: The sensation of inertia strikes again, pushing the two through the closing door together.

units.rawText: Angelus' shield makes it in time to stop the two from having an intimate encounter with the floor.
units.displayText: Angelus' shield makes it in time to stop the two from having an intimate encounter with the floor.

spans.text: Angelus' shield makes it in time to stop the two from having an intimate encounter with the floor.

units.rawText: I would prefer to not have to go through that again.
units.displayText: I would prefer to not have to go through that again.

spans.text: I would prefer to not have to go through that again.

units.rawText: When we get back I'm going to file an official complaint. You got that, Antonina?
units.displayText: When we get back I'm going to file an official complaint. You got that, Antonina?

spans.text: When we get back I'm going to file an official complaint. You got that, Antonina?

units.rawText: Antonina?
units.displayText: Antonina?

spans.text: Antonina?

units.rawText: Even calling her name does not elicit a response. Ever since the group had entered the Pantheon, the Doll's gaze has been glued to the light in its center.
units.displayText: Even calling her name does not elicit a response. Ever since the group had entered the Pantheon, the Doll's gaze has been glued to the light in its center.

spans.text: Even calling her name does not elicit a response. Ever since the group had entered the Pantheon, the Doll's gaze has been glued to the light in its center.

units.rawText: That's... the <color=orange>Sanctifiers' Sacred Canon</color>, huh...
units.displayText: That's... the Sanctifiers' Sacred Canon, huh...

spans.text: That's... the
Sanctifiers' Sacred Canon
, huh...

units.rawText: Yes, a tome of unthinkable value containing all information related to Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Yes, a tome of unthinkable value containing all information related to Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Yes, a tome of unthinkable value containing all information related to Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: The information of every Sanctifier, past and present, is contained within. Not only that, it also keeps the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower in good working order. It would be no exaggeration to say that it is our most important possession.
units.displayText: The information of every Sanctifier, past and present, is contained within. Not only that, it also keeps the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower in good working order. It would be no exaggeration to say that it is our most important possession.

spans.text: The information of every Sanctifier, past and present, is contained within. Not only that, it also keeps the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower in good working order. It would be no exaggeration to say that it is our most important possession.

units.rawText: Yeah, I can understand how important it is...
units.displayText: Yeah, I can understand how important it is...

spans.text: Yeah, I can understand how important it is...

units.rawText: This familiar feeling... just what...
units.displayText: This familiar feeling... just what...

spans.text: This familiar feeling... just what...

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: The Doll is tackled to the ground before she can even begin to react. A projectile of operands penetrates the wall behind her, leaving a clean hole where she stood just a moment ago.
units.displayText: The Doll is tackled to the ground before she can even begin to react. A projectile of operands penetrates the wall behind her, leaving a clean hole where she stood just a moment ago.

spans.text: The Doll is tackled to the ground before she can even begin to react. A projectile of operands penetrates the wall behind her, leaving a clean hole where she stood just a moment ago.

units.rawText: Even if she tried to avoid it, I'm pretty confident that would have worked... did you do something, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Even if she tried to avoid it, I'm pretty confident that would have worked... did you do something, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Even if she tried to avoid it, I'm pretty confident that would have worked... did you do something, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Without waiting for an answer, Eucharist finds the answer she's looking for in the flowing operands.
units.displayText: Without waiting for an answer, Eucharist finds the answer she's looking for in the flowing operands.

spans.text: Without waiting for an answer, Eucharist finds the answer she's looking for in the flowing operands.

units.rawText: Ah, so that's what it was, you left a shield for them. No wonder the attack started deviating when it got close.
units.displayText: Ah, so that's what it was, you left a shield for them. No wonder the attack started deviating when it got close.

spans.text: Ah, so that's what it was, you left a shield for them. No wonder the attack started deviating when it got close.

units.rawText: You do indeed have the right to face me, having taken care of all the Entropics in this Tower... But...
units.displayText: You do indeed have the right to face me, having taken care of all the Entropics in this Tower... But...

spans.text: You do indeed have the right to face me, having taken care of all the Entropics in this Tower... But...

units.rawText: ...Do you still have the strength to fight me, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: ...Do you still have the strength to fight me, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: ...Do you still have the strength to fight me, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier ignores the malignant mockery, calling her weapon to her side.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier ignores the malignant mockery, calling her weapon to her side.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier ignores the malignant mockery, calling her weapon to her side.

units.rawText: You two, take good care of yourselves. I might not have an opportunity to watch over you later.
units.displayText: You two, take good care of yourselves. I might not have an opportunity to watch over you later.

spans.text: You two, take good care of yourselves. I might not have an opportunity to watch over you later.

units.rawText: Yeah, you go do your thing. I'll run analysis on the Sacred Canon while you're at it and try to get its ownership transferred over.
units.displayText: Yeah, you go do your thing. I'll run analysis on the Sacred Canon while you're at it and try to get its ownership transferred over.

spans.text: Yeah, you go do your thing. I'll run analysis on the Sacred Canon while you're at it and try to get its ownership transferred over.

units.rawText: Your human permissions... Professor.
units.displayText: Your human permissions... Professor.

spans.text: Your human permissions... Professor.

units.rawText: Yeah, got it.
units.displayText: Yeah, got it.

spans.text: Yeah, got it.

units.rawText: Any other instructions or requests before we begin?
units.displayText: Any other instructions or requests before we begin?

spans.text: Any other instructions or requests before we begin?

units.rawText: I don't think so. Just like before...
units.displayText: I don't think so. Just like before...

spans.text: I don't think so. Just like before...

units.rawText: They extend a fist, lightly touching Angelus' shoulder.
units.displayText: They extend a fist, lightly touching Angelus' shoulder.

spans.text: They extend a fist, lightly touching Angelus' shoulder.

units.rawText: Show me the glory of the Sanctifiers, Angelus.
units.displayText: Show me the glory of the Sanctifiers, Angelus.

spans.text: Show me the glory of the Sanctifiers, Angelus.

units.rawText: Of course, I shall display it in its entirety... For both you and them.
units.displayText: Of course, I shall display it in its entirety... For both you and them.

spans.text: Of course, I shall display it in its entirety... For both you and them.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier's mechanical wings spread as she grips the weapon in her hand tight, honoring her agreement and duty.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier's mechanical wings spread as she grips the weapon in her hand tight, honoring her agreement and duty.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier's mechanical wings spread as she grips the weapon in her hand tight, honoring her agreement and duty.

units.rawText: I shall bring us victory, as agreed upon.
units.displayText: I shall bring us victory, as agreed upon.

spans.text: I shall bring us victory, as agreed upon.

units.rawText: Done with the theatrics?
units.displayText: Done with the theatrics?

spans.text: Done with the theatrics?

units.rawText: Mm.
units.displayText: Mm.

spans.text: Mm.

units.rawText: She forms a golden arrow in her hand, resolutely directing it at her former sister.
units.displayText: She forms a golden arrow in her hand, resolutely directing it at her former sister.

spans.text: She forms a golden arrow in her hand, resolutely directing it at her former sister.

units.rawText: Well, this is rather proper, no?
units.displayText: Well, this is rather proper, no?

spans.text: Well, this is rather proper, no?

units.rawText: Ever since I left the Reverse Babylon Tower, I've awaited this day.
units.displayText: Ever since I left the Reverse Babylon Tower, I've awaited this day.

spans.text: Ever since I left the Reverse Babylon Tower, I've awaited this day.

units.rawText: Her fork and shield crash together in her hands. The dull metal humming spreads through the vast Pantheon, akin to the clarion call before battle is engaged.
units.displayText: Her fork and shield crash together in her hands. The dull metal humming spreads through the vast Pantheon, akin to the clarion call before battle is engaged.

spans.text: Her fork and shield crash together in her hands. The dull metal humming spreads through the vast Pantheon, akin to the clarion call before battle is engaged.

units.rawText: Remember this, Big Sis? Every time we sparred, we would use the cessation of this sound as the signal to start.
units.displayText: Remember this, Big Sis? Every time we sparred, we would use the cessation of this sound as the signal to start.

spans.text: Remember this, Big Sis? Every time we sparred, we would use the cessation of this sound as the signal to start.

units.rawText: ...This will be the last time.
units.displayText: ...This will be the last time.

spans.text: ...This will be the last time.

units.rawText: Indeed. Will you please not bore me, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Indeed. Will you please not bore me, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Indeed. Will you please not bore me, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: The humming ceases as the two speak. In the very next moment, the scene of carnage shatters whatever happiness left of the past.
units.displayText: The humming ceases as the two speak. In the very next moment, the scene of carnage shatters whatever happiness left of the past.

spans.text: The humming ceases as the two speak. In the very next moment, the scene of carnage shatters whatever happiness left of the past.

units.rawText: Golden arrows fall like rain upon Eucharist. She runs and leaps, blocking with her shield as she evades.
units.displayText: Golden arrows fall like rain upon Eucharist. She runs and leaps, blocking with her shield as she evades.

spans.text: Golden arrows fall like rain upon Eucharist. She runs and leaps, blocking with her shield as she evades.

units.rawText: Ever so fond of creating distance like before... ha!
units.displayText: Ever so fond of creating distance like before... ha!

spans.text: Ever so fond of creating distance like before... ha!

units.rawText: After evading the rain of arrows with several tumbles, operands coalesce on her weapon.
units.displayText: After evading the rain of arrows with several tumbles, operands coalesce on her weapon.

spans.text: After evading the rain of arrows with several tumbles, operands coalesce on her weapon.

units.rawText: <size=40>Here!</size>
units.displayText: Here!

spans.text: Here!

units.rawText: In a split second, the fork in Eucharist's hand flies against the rain of arrows, aimed right between Angelus' eyes.
units.displayText: In a split second, the fork in Eucharist's hand flies against the rain of arrows, aimed right between Angelus' eyes.

spans.text: In a split second, the fork in Eucharist's hand flies against the rain of arrows, aimed right between Angelus' eyes.

units.rawText: Her shields having been transferred, Angelus can only evade with a turn to the side, the outpouring of arrows having given pause.
units.displayText: Her shields having been transferred, Angelus can only evade with a turn to the side, the outpouring of arrows having given pause.

spans.text: Her shields having been transferred, Angelus can only evade with a turn to the side, the outpouring of arrows having given pause.

units.rawText: <size=40>It's not over yet!</size>
units.displayText: It's not over yet!

spans.text: It's not over yet!

units.rawText: Taking advantage of the lull, Eucharist flies towards Angelus alongside her weapon, priming an operand-enhanced flying kick.
units.displayText: Taking advantage of the lull, Eucharist flies towards Angelus alongside her weapon, priming an operand-enhanced flying kick.

spans.text: Taking advantage of the lull, Eucharist flies towards Angelus alongside her weapon, priming an operand-enhanced flying kick.

units.rawText: Angelus blocks the strike with her bow, letting loose a fully drawn shot in the nick of time. Eucharist blocks it with her shield, using the opportunity to pull back.
units.displayText: Angelus blocks the strike with her bow, letting loose a fully drawn shot in the nick of time. Eucharist blocks it with her shield, using the opportunity to pull back.

spans.text: Angelus blocks the strike with her bow, letting loose a fully drawn shot in the nick of time. Eucharist blocks it with her shield, using the opportunity to pull back.

units.rawText: In a flash, both launch attacks at the other's weapon-wielding hand, but neither can find a gap in their opponent's defense.
units.displayText: In a flash, both launch attacks at the other's weapon-wielding hand, but neither can find a gap in their opponent's defense.

spans.text: In a flash, both launch attacks at the other's weapon-wielding hand, but neither can find a gap in their opponent's defense.

units.rawText: Nice one, Big Sis. That shot was quite interesting.
units.displayText: Nice one, Big Sis. That shot was quite interesting.

spans.text: Nice one, Big Sis. That shot was quite interesting.

units.rawText: Eucharist pulls her fork out of the wall, nonchalantly patting away the dust on her clothing.
units.displayText: Eucharist pulls her fork out of the wall, nonchalantly patting away the dust on her clothing.

spans.text: Eucharist pulls her fork out of the wall, nonchalantly patting away the dust on her clothing.

units.rawText: ...How did you know I would fire that shot? That should have been a visual dead zone.
units.displayText: ...How did you know I would fire that shot? That should have been a visual dead zone.

spans.text: ...How did you know I would fire that shot? That should have been a visual dead zone.

units.rawText: Angelus returns her fallen, scattered arrows to operands before retrieving them and nocking an arrow once more.
units.displayText: Angelus returns her fallen, scattered arrows to operands before retrieving them and nocking an arrow once more.

spans.text: Angelus returns her fallen, scattered arrows to operands before retrieving them and nocking an arrow once more.

units.rawText: Perhaps I just understand you too well? I know even things you cannot conceive of~
units.displayText: Perhaps I just understand you too well? I know even things you cannot conceive of~

spans.text: Perhaps I just understand you too well? I know even things you cannot conceive of~

units.rawText: ...Foul trickery.
units.displayText: ...Foul trickery.

spans.text: ...Foul trickery.

units.rawText: She looses her arrows again, signaling the start of round two.
units.displayText: She looses her arrows again, signaling the start of round two.

spans.text: She looses her arrows again, signaling the start of round two.

units.rawText: So that's what a fight between Greater Sanctifiers looks like... scary.
units.displayText: So that's what a fight between Greater Sanctifiers looks like... scary.

spans.text: So that's what a fight between Greater Sanctifiers looks like... scary.

units.rawText: Take care not to get caught up in it. We have a job to do.
units.displayText: Take care not to get caught up in it. We have a job to do.

spans.text: Take care not to get caught up in it. We have a job to do.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll links her computer to the Sacred Canon. Countless pop-ups appear and she dismisses them swiftly.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll links her computer to the Sacred Canon. Countless pop-ups appear and she dismisses them swiftly.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll links her computer to the Sacred Canon. Countless pop-ups appear and she dismisses them swiftly.

units.rawText: How goes the analysis?
units.displayText: How goes the analysis?

spans.text: How goes the analysis?

units.rawText: There's more data in the Sacred Canon than I imagined. More importantly...
units.displayText: There's more data in the Sacred Canon than I imagined. More importantly...

spans.text: There's more data in the Sacred Canon than I imagined. More importantly...

units.rawText: Antonina bites down on her lower lip, speeding up her operations on the keyboard.
units.displayText: Antonina bites down on her lower lip, speeding up her operations on the keyboard.

spans.text: Antonina bites down on her lower lip, speeding up her operations on the keyboard.

units.rawText: An irreversible Entropization program has already been implanted.
units.displayText: An irreversible Entropization program has already been implanted.

spans.text: An irreversible Entropization program has already been implanted.

units.rawText: Damn it! That bastard Eosphorus is determined on Entropizing the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower!
units.displayText: Damn it! That bastard Eosphorus is determined on Entropizing the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower!

spans.text: Damn it! That bastard Eosphorus is determined on Entropizing the entirety of the Reverse Babylon Tower!

units.rawText: ...Anything we can do about it?
units.displayText: ...Anything we can do about it?

spans.text: ...Anything we can do about it?

units.rawText: I'm using your permissions to do what I can, but I cannot stop the Entropization program.
units.displayText: I'm using your permissions to do what I can, but I cannot stop the Entropization program.

spans.text: I'm using your permissions to do what I can, but I cannot stop the Entropization program.

units.rawText: Judging from the state of things, all I can do is transfer the non-Entropized parts. The already Entropized part is unsalvageable.
units.displayText: Judging from the state of things, all I can do is transfer the non-Entropized parts. The already Entropized part is unsalvageable.

spans.text: Judging from the state of things, all I can do is transfer the non-Entropized parts. The already Entropized part is unsalvageable.

units.rawText: So you mean... Many of the Sanctifiers in the field are already bound to the fate of being Entropized.
units.displayText: So you mean... Many of the Sanctifiers in the field are already bound to the fate of being Entropized.

spans.text: So you mean... Many of the Sanctifiers in the field are already bound to the fate of being Entropized.

units.rawText: The Doll nods, her answer taking the form of her silent anger.
units.displayText: The Doll nods, her answer taking the form of her silent anger.

spans.text: The Doll nods, her answer taking the form of her silent anger.

units.rawText: Calm down, Antonina. Do what you can first.
units.displayText: Calm down, Antonina. Do what you can first.

spans.text: Calm down, Antonina. Do what you can first.

units.rawText: I need to relay the situation here to Hesperus. I'll leave the data transfer to you!
units.displayText: I need to relay the situation here to Hesperus. I'll leave the data transfer to you!

spans.text: I need to relay the situation here to Hesperus. I'll leave the data transfer to you!

units.rawText: ...Yes!
units.displayText: ...Yes!

spans.text: ...Yes!

units.rawText: BOOM!
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: An operand-induced explosion interrupts the duo.
units.displayText: An operand-induced explosion interrupts the duo.

spans.text: An operand-induced explosion interrupts the duo.

units.rawText: As clingy as always, Big Sis Angelus.
units.displayText: As clingy as always, Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: As clingy as always, Big Sis Angelus.

units.rawText: She emerges from the smoke, rushing towards Angelus with her shield as cover.
units.displayText: She emerges from the smoke, rushing towards Angelus with her shield as cover.

spans.text: She emerges from the smoke, rushing towards Angelus with her shield as cover.

units.rawText: Arrow after arrow explode upon the shield, but it does little to stop Eucharist's rapid advance.
units.displayText: Arrow after arrow explode upon the shield, but it does little to stop Eucharist's rapid advance.

spans.text: Arrow after arrow explode upon the shield, but it does little to stop Eucharist's rapid advance.

units.rawText: Angelus immediately changes her strategy, instead launching a series of explosive arrows in Eucharist's path.
units.displayText: Angelus immediately changes her strategy, instead launching a series of explosive arrows in Eucharist's path.

spans.text: Angelus immediately changes her strategy, instead launching a series of explosive arrows in Eucharist's path.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.displayText: The explosions create great craters on the ground, forcibly halting Eucharist's steps.

spans.text: The explosions create great craters on the ground, forcibly halting Eucharist's steps.

units.rawText: ...Sanctifiers can fly, you know!
units.displayText: ...Sanctifiers can fly, you know!

spans.text: ...Sanctifiers can fly, you know!

units.rawText: Eucharist leaps high into the air, using the ceiling as a launchpad and rushing forward with her weapon.
units.displayText: Eucharist leaps high into the air, using the ceiling as a launchpad and rushing forward with her weapon.

spans.text: Eucharist leaps high into the air, using the ceiling as a launchpad and rushing forward with her weapon.

units.rawText: Checkmate.
units.displayText: Checkmate.

spans.text: Checkmate.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.displayText: Eucharist's body suddenly halts in midair. Before she realizes something is off, she is already surrounded by countless golden arrows.

spans.text: Eucharist's body suddenly halts in midair. Before she realizes something is off, she is already surrounded by countless golden arrows.

units.rawText: When did...
units.displayText: When did...

spans.text: When did...

units.displayText: Her surprise is interrupted by countless explosions. Her body is ejected from the cloud of smoke like a stray piece of fabric, slamming into the building's walls.

spans.text: Her surprise is interrupted by countless explosions. Her body is ejected from the cloud of smoke like a stray piece of fabric, slamming into the building's walls.

units.rawText: Ow...
units.displayText: Ow...

spans.text: Ow...

units.displayText: She moves to get up, only to find a blinding golden arrow in her face.

spans.text: She moves to get up, only to find a blinding golden arrow in her face.

units.rawText: You've lost, Eucharist.
units.displayText: You've lost, Eucharist.

spans.text: You've lost, Eucharist.

units.rawText: Do you mean to have me surrender, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Do you mean to have me surrender, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Do you mean to have me surrender, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: You have no other options.
units.displayText: You have no other options.

spans.text: You have no other options.

units.rawText: ...It really is a pain to fight you, Big Sis Angelus. Can't have either a good fight or chat.
units.displayText: ...It really is a pain to fight you, Big Sis Angelus. Can't have either a good fight or chat.

spans.text: The loser looks over at the two working on the Sacred Canon, letting go of the weapon in her hand.

units.rawText: By the way, isn't it a bit against the rules to pre-place those arrows? Doesn't that go against your Sanctifier brand of glory and honor?

spans.text: I cannot lose this battle, lest the honor of the Sanctifiers be tarnished.

units.rawText: Honor... hah, honor...
units.displayText: Honor... hah, honor...

spans.text: Honor... hah, honor...

units.rawText: Do you really not see things for what they are, still?

spans.text: Do you really not see things for what they are, still?

units.rawText: Duty? Ahaha...<size=40>HAHAHAHA!</size>
units.displayText: Duty? Ahaha...HAHAHAHA!

spans.text: Duty? Ahaha...
HAHAHAHA!

units.displayText: Eucharist's laughter echoes through the Pantheon.

units.rawText: I've given you the time, but you really haven't gotten it at all, Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: I've given you the time, but you really haven't gotten it at all, Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: It's related to your nature, of course... The "second shot" I've prepared for you.

units.rawText: ...I've given you a chance to surrender too, but you've only used it to mutter nonsense.

units.rawText: Hold on just a second! You can't just hurry these things, Big Sis Angelus. I'm more useful to you alive than dead.

units.rawText: What are you after?
units.displayText: What are you after?

spans.text: What are you after?

spans.text: Don't be so nervous. I want to help you.

units.rawText: Eosphorus told me to watch over it, but truth be told I don't give a damn.

units.rawText: A story with an ending so far set in stone is far too boring. Do allow me to make it a bit more interesting.

spans.text: A story with an ending so far set in stone is far too boring. Do allow me to make it a bit more interesting.

units.rawText: My Sanctifier permissions. There's no trap or anything, you can check if you'd like. Not like I particularly care for my identity as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Antonina inspects the key with some suspicion, making sure that it is safe.

units.rawText: ...It's safe. We can stop the Entropization with these permissions.
units.displayText: ...It's safe. We can stop the Entropization with these permissions.

units.rawText: Hehe, see, I wasn't lying.
units.displayText: Hehe, see, I wasn't lying.

units.displayText: Nothing.

units.displayText: Hehe...

spans.text: Hehe...

units.displayText: What do you want, Eucharist?

units.rawText: And the rest of the Sacred Canon would go "BOOM!" and be on their merry way to be infected... Hehe, that doesn't sound so bad.

units.rawText: Well, I wanted to have a more relaxed conversation, but this will do.
units.displayText: Well, I wanted to have a more relaxed conversation, but this will do.

spans.text: Well, I wanted to have a more relaxed conversation, but this will do.

units.rawText: Big Sis, you've always wanted to know about the relationship between you and Electra, right?
units.displayText: Big Sis, you've always wanted to know about the relationship between you and Electra, right?

spans.text: Big Sis, you've always wanted to know about the relationship between you and Electra, right?

units.rawText: Just why you two are so similar, and why a familiar feeling arises whenever something about Electra comes up.
units.displayText: Just why you two are so similar, and why a familiar feeling arises whenever something about Electra comes up.

spans.text: Just why you two are so similar, and why a familiar feeling arises whenever something about Electra comes up.

units.rawText: ...How did you know of that?
units.displayText: ...How did you know of that?

spans.text: ...How did you know of that?

units.rawText: Because I'm the same way, "Big Sis". From the very beginning, I've been your little sister.
units.displayText: Because I'm the same way, "Big Sis". From the very beginning, I've been your little sister.

spans.text: Because I'm the same way, "Big Sis". From the very beginning, I've been your little sister.

units.rawText: ...Even when you were Electra.
units.displayText: ...Even when you were Electra.

spans.text: ...Even when you were Electra.

units.rawText: Sad thing is that we cannot possibly replicate their personalities, nor can the glory of the Sanctifiers ever be ours. We are destined to be second-rate imitations, fakers. Do you know why?
units.displayText: Sad thing is that we cannot possibly replicate their personalities, nor can the glory of the Sanctifiers ever be ours. We are destined to be second-rate imitations, fakers. Do you know why?

spans.text: Sad thing is that we cannot possibly replicate their personalities, nor can the glory of the Sanctifiers ever be ours. We are destined to be second-rate imitations, fakers. Do you know why?

spans.text: Hehe, I'm sure you've guessed already, because you know what happened to Electra and Alcyone.

units.displayText: Warning, individual "Electra" Entropization rate 99%.

spans.text: Mhmm. The Entropized Sacred Canon ought to have been deleted, but Eosphorus held onto it.

units.rawText: Because he missed Electra and Alcyone so much, he created us with their corrupted data. Our Sacred Canons have never been touched by the Lord's grace. We are not Sanctifiers.
